args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 18%). Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy release. The initial rollback partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy with a 0.2% error rate across all regions. v2.3.1 remains undeployed and should be investigated for the root cause of the health check failures.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback:**
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1.
- I retried the rollback, which completed successfully — all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
- Verified post-rollback: checkout-api is **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate across all regions.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), and the recovered state. Note: the incident creation request returned a timeout error, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created — the on-call engineer has been paged. v2.3.1 remains undeployed and should be investigated for the root cause.
